weeklyReview.title: Weekly Review
weeklyReview.accountUnavailable: We couldn’t verify your account. Reopen My Workspace to try again.
weeklyReview.localSource: Based on records available in this browser.
weeklyReview.useLocalPrompt: Calendar, To-do, and Idea Box records are stored in this browser and may be shared by people who use it. Use these records for the weekly review?
weeklyReview.useLocal: Use local records for this review
weeklyReview.temporaryAccess: This browser couldn’t save your preference for the next visit.
weeklyReview.incomplete: Some local records couldn’t be read. This review may be incomplete.
weeklyReview.snapshotNote: This review uses the records currently available. It can’t recover deleted records, earlier task states, or earlier Idea Box check-ins.

groupNotes.completed: To-dos with a recorded completion date in the selected week.
groupNotes.openDue: Currently open, due by the selected week’s end or without a due date.
groupNotes.scheduled: Events scheduled for this week. Attendance and outcomes aren’t recorded here.
groupNotes.ideaProgress: Ideas whose latest recorded check-in falls in the selected week.
groupNotes.needsFollowUp: Based on update dates and check-ins available now.

weeklyReview.emptyGroup: None found in the available records.
weeklyReview.unknownCompletionDates: {count, plural, one {# task is marked complete without a usable completion date. It isn’t counted in this week.} other {# tasks are marked complete without usable completion dates. They aren’t counted in this week.}}

coach.title: Workspace Coach
coach.localOnly: The local review is available without an account. Coach summaries require sign-in.
coach.notEnoughData: There aren’t enough recorded items for a Coach summary.
coach.sharing: The Coach receives only the review dates and counts. Record titles, notes, and conversations stay private.
coach.failed: The Coach couldn’t summarize this review. Your local review is still available.

dailyCheckIn.title: Daily Briefing
dailyCheckIn.scopeUnavailable: We couldn’t verify your account for this check-in. Reopen My Workspace to try again.
dailyCheckIn.localBadge: Based on records in this browser
dailyCheckIn.localAccess: Your Calendar, To-do, and Idea Box records are stored in this browser and may be shared by people who use it. Use these local records for your daily briefing?
dailyCheckIn.incomplete: Some saved records couldn’t be read. This briefing may be incomplete.
dailyCheckIn.storageError: This browser couldn’t save or read check-in preferences. Changes aren’t confirmed.
dailyCheckIn.more: {count, plural, one {# more in your records} other {# more in your records}}
dailyCheckIn.questionHint: One question to help you make your next move.

questions.overdue: Would you like to check where this to-do stands?
questions.dueToday: What is the next step for this to-do today?
questions.dueSoon: Is there anything you’d like to prepare before this to-do is due?
questions.importantEvent: What would you like to prepare for this event?
questions.missingNextStep: What small next step would you choose for this idea?
questions.calendarConflict: Would you like to check whether these events conflict?
questions.calendarFollowUp: Is there anything from this scheduled event you’d like to follow up on?
questions.staleTodo: What would help you move this to-do forward?
questions.ideaPlanNoProgress: What progress would you like to record for this idea?
questions.staleIdea: What would you like to update about this idea?

facts.overdue: The due date has passed, and this to-do is still marked open.
facts.dueToday: This to-do is due today and is marked open.
facts.dueSoon: This to-do is due within three days and is marked open.
facts.importantEvent: This calendar event is marked with an elevated priority.
facts.missingNextStep: This idea is marked in progress and has no next step recorded.
facts.calendarConflict: These events have the same recorded start time. Their durations aren’t recorded, so an overlap isn’t confirmed.
facts.calendarFollowUp: Calendar shows this event was scheduled for an earlier day. It doesn’t record whether the event took place.
facts.staleTodo: This important to-do is still marked open, and its last recorded update is at least {days} days old.
facts.ideaPlanNoProgress: This idea has a next step or a linked task, but there’s no check-in recorded in Idea Box.
facts.staleIdea: The latest recorded update for this idea is at least {days} days old.

dailyCheckIn.answerPrivacy: Your answer stays in this browser. It won’t change the original record or be sent to AI.
dailyCheckIn.savedAnswers: {count, plural, one {# saved answer} other {# saved answers}}
dailyCheckIn.enhancePrivacy: The AI receives only the reminder type and your language.
dailyCheckIn.aiUnavailable: AI couldn’t rephrase this right now. You can still use the original question.
dailyCheckIn.snoozeUntil: Snoozed until {date}. It can return here if it’s still relevant.

notices.muted: Questions about this topic are muted.
